notes.title: World 2 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26815081/3aed57313da093347bc665401ce431a03966c211.png[/img]

Just pushed an update last night that makes the water in the Island Life world look approximately 1000x better! It also should be much more performant, so it's a double win. Neat!

Changelog:
- Removed boring water
- Added dope water
- Removed penguin santa hats 

Check er out!

notes.title: Balance update
notes.content:
This patch tweaks the handling of each of the bikes, particularly the Penny Farthing, to make them more stable and controllable. The Unicycle was a bit TOO stable, so we toned that down a tad such that it is no longer the obvious choice for every race. : )

PLUS a shiny new splash screen, neat!

notes.title: BMX Update + Fixes
notes.content:
Over the weekend we added a whole new bike to play as, the BMX! 

Other changes/fixes include:

- Fixed some typos in credits screen
- Control scheme changing for gamepad uses dpad up/down during bike selection instead of left/right. This helps prevent accidentally changing your controls when trying to select a bike.

notes.title: Patch to fix Achievements bug
notes.content:
Hello all, we hope you are enjoying the game!

We've noticed a couple bugs and are pushing a patch very soon.

- Fix for all achievements getting unlocked immediately. Those of you who already played and encountered this bug: Sorry! Unfortunately we can't reset your achievement state, so on the bright side, think of all the time you saved!

- Fix for the time counter sometimes incorrectly showing in the center of the screen while in single player mode. 

That's all for now, ride on!
